            session, ride_position, at_seconds, power_watts, cadence_rpm,
            resistance_percentage, speed_millimetres_per_hour
        )
        SELECT ?, ?, value ->> 0, value ->> 1, value ->> 2, value ->> 3, value ->> 4
          FROM json_each(?)
